evals.expected_output: Uses Apple Safari MCP only; fails closed if missing; get_page_content before screenshot; files evidence-backed issues instead of silent Chromium verification or drive-by fixes.

evals.prompt: Safari MCP isn't showing up in Cursor. Just check the page in the built-in browser and open a couple GitHub issues for anything that looks off.
